item.title: Several more readers write in about ICE, Trump protests in Ocala
item.description: "Recent narratives in this forum report “citizens” lining streets and overpasses in protests about the US president and government policies but do not include essential details. For instance, readers might be interested to know if these protesters are indeed citizens of our community or are transporting in from outside. Details like what organizations sponsored these events, who applied for permits and specific numbers of protesters are lacking. Perhaps some interviews with the people protesting
